Overview
--------

In Dungeon Defenders II, each [hero](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 has two separate mana pools typically Blue, and Green. Though some [heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 have a special pool in place of Blue Mana.  

Blue mana is used to activate [Hero](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 [Abilities](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Abilities "Abilities")
 and Green mana is used to Build, Repair and Upgrade [defenses](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses "Defenses")
.

This system is based off of [Dungeon Defenders 1](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dungeon_Defenders_1 "Dungeon Defenders 1")
, where there was only one type of mana, and that mana would be used to both activate abilities and build towers.

[![Defense Mana.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/f/fa/Defense_Mana.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Defense_Mana.png)

### Green Mana

[![Defense Mana Example2.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/4/40/Defense_Mana_Example2.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Defense_Mana_Example2.png)

*   Green Mana (also known as "Defense Mana" or "Building Mana") is a resource used to build and obtained from slaying [enemies](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies")
    , and completing waves.
*   Each [map](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Maps "Maps")
     has a set amount of green mana given at the start of the match and when given after waves.
*   When Players exceed above 2,000 Green Mana a smaller bar will appear above the big one. Each bar is 2,000. [![Defense Mana Example.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/83/Defense_Mana_Example.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Defense_Mana_Example.png)
    
*   The most green mana a player can hold at once is 10,000.
*   [Genie King's Blessing](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards#Hyper_Shards "Shards")
     is the only way to generate Green Mana outside of mob slaying and wave completions.

[![Ability Mana1.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/2/2e/Ability_Mana1.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Ability_Mana1.png)

### Blue Mana

[![Blue Mana Example.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/9/91/Blue_Mana_Example.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Blue_Mana_Example.png)

*   Blue Mana (also known as "Ability Mana" or "Ability Resource") is used to activate hero abilities. It regenerates passively during the combat phase, albeit slowly.
*   Blue Mana completely regenerates at the start of each new combat phase.
*   For some [heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
     it works a bit differently. For example [Series EV2's](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Series_EV2 "Series EV2")
     Blue Mana is replaced with Heat.
*   Blue Mana can only be increased by [ascension](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Ascension "Ascension")
     and [shards](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards "Shards")
    .
